description.p: UltraHLE emulates the Nintendo 64, with OpenGL graphics, four controllers with rumble, and per-game settings in ultra.ini.
Put your ROMs in the UltraHLE folder in your home directory (/home/deck/UltraHLE/roms on SteamOS). UltraHLE lists them and you choose one with the controller or the keyboard.
First Linux package. X11/GLX renderer, PulseAudio sound, evdev gamepads with rumble and hotplug, a ROM list in the game window and controller shortcuts for SteamOS.
